text: 平安电工公告，公司拟向特定对象发行A股股票，募资总额不超过13亿元，发行对象不超过三十五名符合条件的特定对象，最终发行对象将根据竞价结果协商确定。募集资金拟用于泰国云母绝缘材料生产基地建设项目2.22亿元、泰国电子布生产基地建设项目4.25亿元、高性能电子布生产基地建设项目3.52亿元及补充流动资金3亿元。方案已获董事会审议通过，尚需股东会审议、深交所审核及中国证监会同意注册。
text_en: Ping An Electric announced that the company plans to issue A-shares to specific targets, with total fundraising not exceeding 1.3 billion yuan, and no more than 35 eligible specific targets, with the final issuance targets to be determined through negotiation based on bidding results. The proceeds are intended for the Thailand mica insulation material production base construction project at 222 million yuan, the Thailand electronic fabric production base construction project at 425 million yuan, the high-performance electronic fabric production base construction project at 352 million yuan, and 300 million yuan to supplement working capital. The plan has been approved by the board of directors and still requires shareholder meeting review, Shenzhen Stock Exchange review, and registration approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
